title: Flickr Publish Photo Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Lightroom photo exports (`lightroom:photo`), Flickr photo metadata (`flickr:photo`), ShutterCount body audits (`shuttercount:camera`), and F3 card tests (`f3:card`).
app: Adobe Lightroom exports, Flickr API metadata, ShutterCount camera audits, and F3 SD-card health checks sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flickr:photo
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(album_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Flickr publish photo events land each day and how many distinct album name values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Flickr publish photo records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct album name values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how much Flickr publish photo activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
